description: Information about an event concerning one or more physical or digital Track and Trace (TT) objects identified by instance or class level identifiers.

actionCode.description: The code specifying the action for this TT object event.

businessRelatedLocation.description: The business location related to this TT object event.

businessStepCode.description: The code specifying the business step for this TT object event.

destinationRelatedParty.description: A destination related party for this TT object event.

dispositionCode.description: The code specifying the disposition related to this TT object event.

identifier.description: The identifier for this TT object event.

objectInstanceId.description: An instance identifier for an object of this TT object event.

occurrenceDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value at which this TT object event occurred.

quantitySpecifiedEventElement.description: A quantity event element specified for this TT object event.

readPointRelatedLocation.description: The read point related location of this TT object event.

recordedDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value at which this TT object event was recorded.

relatedCertification.description: A certification related to this TT object event.

sourceRelatedParty.description: A source related party for this TT object event.

specifiedError.description: A declared error specified for this TT object event.

specifiedTradeTransaction.description: A trade transaction specified for this TT object event.
